expected_result.endpoint_definition: Time to castration-resistant prostate cancer: from randomization to PSA progression with castrate testosterone (<0.5 ng/mL) or radiological progression of soft-tissue, visceral, or bone lesions; soft-tissue/visceral progression by RECIST 1.1 and bone progression by PCWG3
expected_result.population: Patients in the randomized intention-to-treat or primary efficacy analysis population.

reported_scope.analysis_population: Patients in the randomized intention-to-treat or primary efficacy analysis population.

expected_result.window: From randomization to the outcome event or last follow-up at the analysis cutoff reported in the main article.

registry_capture.provenance: captured response retained from OS baseline
